57527-the-great-white-way-a-record-of-an.title: The Great White Way A Record Of An Unusual Voyage Of Discove
57527-the-great-white-way-a-record-of-an.creator: Unknown
57527-the-great-white-way-a-record-of-an.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. For more than ten generations my maternal ancestors have been farers of the sea, and I was born within call of high tide. At the distance of a thousand miles inland it still called me, and often in childhood I woke at night from dreams of a blue harbor with white sails.

arxiv-2012-04144.title: Improved Swarm Engineering: Aligning Intuition and Analysis
arxiv-2012-04144.creator: John Harwell, Maria Gini
arxiv-2012-04144.description: Abstract We present a set of metrics intended to supplement designer intuitions when designing swarm-robotic systems, increase accuracy in extrapolating swarm behavior from algorithmic descriptions and small test experiments, and lead to faster and less costly design cycles. We build on previous works studying self-organizing behaviors in autonomous systems to derive a metric for swarm emergent self-organization.

arxiv-2211-08655.title: Compositional Approximately Bisimilar Abstractions of Interconnected Systems footnoteinfo This work was partly supported by the Google Research Grant, the SERB Start-up Research Grant, the CSR Grant by Nokia Corporation and the ANR PIA funding: ANR-20-IDEES-0002.
arxiv-2211-08655.creator: Belamfedel Alaoui Sadek, Saharsh, Pushpak Jagtap, Adnane Saoud
arxiv-2211-08655.description: Abstract This paper formulates and studies the concepts of approximate (alternating) bisimulation relations characterizing equivalence relations between interconnected systems and their abstractions. These equivalence relations guarantee that the abstraction conserves the original model’s dynamics. We develop a compositional approach for abstraction-based controller synthesis by relying on the notions of approximate composition and incremental input-to-state stability.

arxiv-2307-07078.title: NeutralUniverseMachine : An Empirical Model for the Evolution of H i and H 2 Gas in the Universe
arxiv-2307-07078.creator: Hong Guo, Jing Wang, Michael G. Jones, Peter Behroozi
arxiv-2307-07078.description: Abstract Accurately modeling the cold gas content in the universe is challenging for current theoretical models. We propose a new empirical model https://halos.as.arizona.edu/UniverseMachine/DR1/Gas_Masses_NeutralUniverseMachine/ (catalog NeutralUniverseMachine) for the evolution of H i and H 2 gas along with dark matter halos based on the http://halos.as.arizona.edu/UniverseMachine/DR1/ (catalog UniverseMachine) catalog.

arxiv-2308-04982.title: Exploring Multilingual Text Data Distillation
arxiv-2308-04982.creator: Shivam Sahni, Harsh Patel
arxiv-2308-04982.description: Abstract With the rise of deep learning, large datasets and complex models have become common, requiring significant computing power. To address this, data distillation has emerged as a technique to quickly train models with lower memory and time requirements. However, data distillation on text-based datasets hasn’t been explored much because of the challenges rising due to its discrete nature.

arxiv-2312-15453.title: Switching dynamics in Al/InAs nanowire-based gate-controlled superconducting switch
arxiv-2312-15453.creator: Tosson Elalaily, Martin Berke, Ilari Lilja, Alexander Savin, Gergő Fülöp, Lőrinc Kupás, Thomas Kanne, Jesper Nygård, Péter Makk, Pertti Hakonen, Szabolcs Csonka
arxiv-2312-15453.description: Abstract The observation of the gate-controlled supercurrent (GCS) effect in superconducting nanostructures increased the hopes for realizing a superconducting equivalent of semiconductor field-effect transistors. However, recent works attribute this effect to various leakage-based scenarios, giving rise to a debate on its origin.

arxiv-2402-09179.title: Instruction Backdoor Attacks Against Customized LLMs
arxiv-2402-09179.creator: Rui Zhang Hongwei Li Rui Wen Wenbo Jiang Yuan Zhang, Michael Backes Yun Shen Yang Zhang
arxiv-2402-09179.description: Abstract The increasing demand for customized Large Language Models (LLMs) has led to the development of solutions like GPTs. These solutions facilitate tailored LLM creation via natural language prompts without coding. However, the trustworthiness of third-party custom versions of LLMs remains an essential concern.

arxiv-2509-03593.title: Unraveling the Nature of the Nuclear Transient AT2020adpi
arxiv-2509-03593.creator: Paarmita Pandey 1,2, Jason T. Hinkle 3, Christopher S. Kochanek 1,2, Michael A. Tucker 1,2, Mark T. Reynolds 1,4, Jack M. M. Neustadt 5, Todd A. Thompson 1,2,6, Katie Auchettl 7,8, Benjamin. J. Shappee 3, Aaron Do 9, Dhvanil D. Desai 3, W. B. Hoogendam 3,a, C. Ashall 3, Thomas B. Lowe 3, Melissa Sha
arxiv-2509-03593.description: Abstract Transient events associated with supermassive black holes provide rare opportunities to study accretion and the environments of supermassive black holes. We present a multiwavelength study of AT2020adpi (ZTF20acvfraq), a luminous optical/UV transient in the nucleus of the galaxy WISEA J231853.77 − - 103505.6 ( z = 0.26 z=0.26 ) that exhibits the properties of an ambiguous nuclear transient.

arxiv-2511-11346.title: Fast and Expressive Multi-Token Prediction with Probabilistic Circuits
arxiv-2511-11346.creator: Andreas Grivas Lorenzo Loconte Emile van Krieken Piotr Nawrot Yu Zhao, Euan WielewskiPasquale Minervini Edoardo Ponti Antonio Vergari
arxiv-2511-11346.description: Abstract Multi-token prediction (MTP) is a prominent strategy to significantly speed up generation in large language models (LLMs) , including byte-level LLMs, which are tokeniser-free but prohibitively slow. However, existing MTP methods often sacrifice expressiveness by assuming independence between future tokens.

britannica-1911-ardea.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-ardea.description: Article 'Ardea' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The site of the primitive city, which later became the citadel, is occupied by the modern town; it is situated at the end of a long plateau between two valleys, and protected by perpendicular tufa cliffs some 60 ft. high on all sides except the north-east, where it joins the plateau. Here it is defended by a fine wall of opus quadratum of tufa, in alternate courses of headers and stretchers.

pmc-11367933.title: Role of G protein coupled receptors in acute kidney injury
pmc-11367933.creator: Liangjing Lv, Yong Liu, Jiachuan Xiong, Shaobo Wang, Yan Li, Bo Zhang, Yinghui Huang, Jinghong Zhao
pmc-11367933.description: Acute kidney injury (AKI) is a clinical condition characterized by a rapid decline in kidney function, which is associated with local inflammation and programmed cell death in the kidney. The G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) represent the largest family of signaling transduction proteins in the body, and approximately 40% of drugs on the market target GPCRs.

pmc-11478459.title: Investigation of Temperature at Al/Glass Fiber-Reinforced Polymer Interfaces When Drilling Composites of Different Stacking Arrangements
pmc-11478459.creator: Brahim Salem, Ali Mkaddem, Malek Habak, Yousef Dobah, Makram Elfarhani, Abdessalem Jarraya
pmc-11478459.description: This attempt covers an investigation of cutting temperature at interfaces of Fiber Metal Laminates (FMLs) made of glass fiber-reinforced polymer (GFRP) stacked with an Al2020 alloy. GFRP/Al/GFRP and Al/GFRP/Al composite stacks are both investigated to highlight the effect of stacking arrangement on thermal behavior within the interfaces.

pmc-11508411.title: Increased Cytokine Levels in Seronegative Myositis: Potential Th17 Immune Response Implications
pmc-11508411.creator: Andrea Aguilar-Vazquez, Efrain Chavarria-Avila, José Manuel Gutiérrez-Hernández, Guillermo Toriz-González, Mario Salazar-Paramo, Gabriel Medrano-Ramirez, Steven Vargas-Cañas, Oscar Pizano-Martinez, Cynthia-Alejandra Gomez-Rios, Christian Juarez-Gomez, José-David Medina-Preciado, Maribell Cabrera-Lóp
pmc-11508411.description: Th17 cells are known for producing IL-17 and their role in the pathogenesis of various autoimmune diseases, including myositis. Likewise, the participation of the IL-23/IL-17 pathway in autoimmunity has been confirmed. In this study, we aimed to evaluate the behavior of cytokines in myositis, focusing on the autoantibodies profile and the myositis core set measures.

pmc-11594928.title: Magnesium-Doped Hydroxyapatite Nanofibers for Medicine Applications: Characterization, Antimicrobial Activity, and Cytotoxicity Study
pmc-11594928.creator: Ricardo Pascual Alanis-Gómez, Fabiola Hernández-Rosas, Juan David Olivares-Hernández, Eric Mauricio Rivera-Muñoz, Araceli Zapatero-Gutiérrez, Néstor Méndez-Lozano, José Rafael Alanis-Gómez, Rodrigo Velázquez-Castillo
pmc-11594928.description: Magnesium-doped hydroxyapatite (HAp-Mg) nanofibers show promise for medical applications due to their structural similarity to bone minerals and enhanced biological properties, such as improved biocompatibility and antimicrobial activity. This study synthesized HAp-Mg nanofibers using a microwave-assisted hydrothermal method (MAHM) to evaluate their cytotoxicity, biocompatibility, and antimicrobial efficacy compared to commercial hydroxyapatite (HAp).

pmc-12695266.title: Assessing the impact of radiofrequency ablation on hilar cholangiocarcinoma: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12695266.creator: Haibin Zhou, Hayat Khizar, Jing Wang, Jianfeng Yang
pmc-12695266.description: Background and aims:Hilar cholangiocarcinoma (HC) is a challenging malignancy with limited treatment options. Radiofrequency ablation (RFA) has emerged as a potential palliative treatment, but its efficacy and safety remain controversial. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the impact of RFA + stent (RFA + S) and stent only (S-only) on HC patients.

pmc-12735634.title: Learning from Peers: A Qualitative Study to Inform the Development of a Community Tailored Peer Support Intervention to Support Healthy Infant Growth
pmc-12735634.creator: Colin J Orr, Alexander Acosta, Luis Acosta, Aunchalee E L Palmquist, Carrigan Price, Jennifer Guterriez-Wu, Adriana R Gaona, Edwin B Fisher, Joseph Sharkey
pmc-12735634.description: Background: Obesity is a chronic disease that has negative health consequences for children. Peer support models have been used to manage chronic diseases like diabetes; however, little is known about how a peer support intervention might promote healthy infant growth to prevent pediatric obesity.

pmc-12956819.title: Integration of learned artificial sensation with vision during freely moving navigation
pmc-12956819.creator: Samuel J. Senneka, Maria C. Dadarlat
pmc-12956819.description: SignificanceMultisensory integration of visual and proprioceptive information facilitates accurate and precise movements. Intracortical microstimulation (ICMS) elicits perceptions that could supplement visual information for patients controlling a prosthesis. Here, we developed a freely moving mouse behavioral task to examine how ICMS can be used to encode multivariable task-relevant information.

pmc-13393208.title: An Experimental Study of the Effect of Dynamic N2 Injection on the Emission and Diffusion Dynamics of Coalbed Methane
pmc-13393208.creator: Haiteng Xue, Junjian Ye
pmc-13393208.description: N2 displacement technology is widely regarded as a promising approach for enhancing coalbed methane recovery. However, the broader application of conventional N2-ECBM has been constrained by low N2 utilization efficiency and high operating costs. Dynamic N2-ECBM can significantly improve both N2 utilization efficiency and displacement performance, yet it still lacks sufficient theoretical support.

pmc-13462645.title: Diagnostic Performance of Ultrasonography Compared to Cross-Sectional Imaging in Thyroid-Related Nodal Metastasis: A Retrospective Cohort Study from Saudi Arabia
pmc-13462645.creator: Alzahraa Mustafa Alawami, Abdulaziz Al-Sharydah, Mishael M AlObaid, Zahra AlShabeeb, Jomana Alnasser, Maryam Aldeen, Fatimah Abbas A Aldawood, Mohammed Ahmed Al Mulhim, Mohammed S AlAftan, Hussain Al-Arfaj, Ahmad M Al-Essa
pmc-13462645.description: BackgroundAccurate detection of metastatic cervical lymph nodes in thyroid cancer is needed for treatment planning. The present study evaluated the diagnostic performance of ultrasound (US), computed tomography (CT), and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for detecting metastatic cervical lymph nodes in a Saudi cohort.
